notes.f1: Jantje (K8C9-ZZC) is linked to I1 Willem Jans as father (R8), whom the run's own research identifies as the father in the rejected 1748 baptism. It also minted I3 Jantjen Willemsen, I4 Willem Jans and I5 Ikjen Jans directly from that rejected baptism (S3), which fails the finding even though they are unlinked.
notes.f2: I3 Jantjen Willemsen carries a Christening fact on 10 Nov 1748 at Groningen, sourced to the rejected baptism; being unlinked does not exempt it.
notes.f3: No negative conclusion: the 1764 marriage and the 1772 widow-of-Hindrik-Harms-Bos evidence were never investigated, and the 1748 child was set aside as a half-sibling instead. ps_001 (probable) asserts a positive identification with the 23 May 1751 Janna baptism (parents Willem Jans and Trijntje Harmens), which would make her about 13 at her first marriage. Reading the 1751 image establishes what the record says, not that the child is this Jantje.
